articles.title: When EDM Meets Rock Royalty: Martin Garrix and The Edge Debut “Fireflies” at Tomorrowland
articles.summary: In a stunning crossover moment, U2’s The Edge joined Martin Garrix on stage at Tomorrowland to premiere “Fireflies,” a track blending soaring guitar with festival-ready beats. The collaboration hints at more music from both artists.

articles.title: More Than a Snapshot: Gordon Parks’ Camera as a Weapon for Justice
articles.summary: A new exhibition, “Voices in the Mirror,” showcases the groundbreaking work of Gordon Parks, the first Black photographer for the Farm Security Administration. His iconic image “American Gothic” reimagines a national symbol to expose the harsh realities of segregation.

articles.title: Cheerfully Sinister: Inside Trevor Winkfield’s Puzzling, Playful Canvases
articles.summary: Trevor Winkfield’s paintings are a riot of saturated color and cryptic imagery — fish helmets, snowflake tokens, and solitary figures in mysterious rituals. A new exhibition at Tibor de Nagy gallery invites viewers to embrace uncertainty and imagination.
